  fun {α} {p} {n} H s hs =>
    let
      -- Define a helper function to perform the induction
      -- This function uses well-founded recursion on the multiset order
      -- restricted to multisets of cardinality at most n.
      f : Multiset α → s.card ≤ n → p s :=
        fun t ht =>
          -- Use the well-founded recursion principle for the multiset order
          -- restricted to multisets of cardinality at most n.
          @WellFounded.fix (Multiset α) (· < ·) (by
            -- Prove that the multiset order is well-founded when restricted to multisets of cardinality at most n
            have h : ∀ (t₁ : Multiset α), t₁.card ≤ n → ∀ (t₂ : Multiset α), t₂.card ≤ n → t₁ < t₂ → t₂.card < n ∨ t₁.card < t₂.card := by
              intro t₁ ht₁ t₂ ht₂ hlt
              have h₁ : t₁.card < t₂.card := by
                -- Use the fact that if t₁ < t₂, then t₁.card < t₂.card
                have h₂ : t₁.card < t₂.card := by
                  apply Multiset.card_lt_card hlt
                exact h₂
              exact Or.inr h₁
            -- Use the fact that the multiset order is well-founded when restricted to multisets of cardinality at most n
            exact
              (by
                -- Use the fact that the multiset order is well-founded when restricted to multisets of cardinality at most n
                exact
                  (WellFounded.trans
                    (WellFounded.rfl : WellFounded (· < ·))
                    (WellFounded.fix (fun n ih => by
                      -- Use the fact that the multiset order is well-founded when restricted to multisets of cardinality at most n
                      have h₁ : ∀ (t₁ : Multiset α), t₁.card ≤ n → ∀ (t₂ : Multiset α), t₂.card ≤ n → t₁ < t₂ → t₂.card < n ∨ t₁.card < t₂.card := by
                        intro t₁ ht₁ t₂ ht₂ hlt
                        have h₂ : t₁.card < t₂.card := by
                          apply Multiset.card_lt_card hlt
                        exact Or.inr h₂

                      have h₂ : WellFounded (· < ·) := by
                        exact (Multiset.wf : WellFounded (· < ·))
                      exact by
                        -- Use the fact that the multiset order is well-founded when restricted to multisets of cardinality at most n
                        simp_all [Nat.lt_succ_iff]

                        <;>

                        <;>
